messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT — streaming pipeline p99 latency spike detected for /v1/stream responses in us-west-2. p99 jumped from 320ms -> 3.2s in last 5m. Some clients reporting stalled chunks. Auto-incident created: INC-3505555555 :rotating_light:
metrics-bot: current snapshot: p50=45ms p95=410ms p99=3.2s error-rate=0.6% streaming-retries=0.9% on the path gateway->proxy->runtime
oncall-elaine: oncall here. paging now. putting ingress on monitoring only, will start triage. any customer-facing alerts?
customer-success-amy: CS: one Enterprise account saw degraded streaming for a few minutes, they reported resumed but slower chunk cadence. No official ticket yet but I messaged them.
ryan_infra: looking at proxy logs, seeing a burst of `upstream write timeout` from the sidecar proxy around 02:12:14. Lots of `writev returned EAGAIN` too. Memory buffers spiked on a subset of gateways.
sre_tess: can you paste the envoy/haproxy snippets? also are we seeing client backpressure (slow consumer) or server-side blocking?
ryan_infra: snippet: ```
[2026-02-14T02:12:14Z] proxy=sidecar-12 host=gw-7 upstream="10.3.4.5:8080" level=warn msg="upstream write timeout" code=110
[2026-02-14T02:12:14Z] proxy=sidecar-12 level=info msg="tcp buffer used=98%"```
looks like certain gateways hit buffer limits when many long-lived SSE connections had bursts of tokens.
eng-runtime: runtime traces show the KV cache occasionally blocking on GC pauses in the qcache worker at the same time — but latency there is ~200ms, not multiple seconds. I think the dominant signal is proxy-level backpressure + slow client drains.
oncall-elaine: immediate mitigations: 1) reduce proxy upstream flush interval (shorten buffering), 2) enable connection-level keepalive and disable HTTP/1.1 chunk coalescing for affected pods, 3) temporarily route a percentage to fallback low-throughput pool to reduce pressure. I'll coordinate.
eng-runtime: I can spin up an extra fallback pool (smaller model, isolated nodes) and route 15% of streaming traffic there. That should reduce pressure on primary pool.
ryan_infra: increasing envoy `upstream_max_pending_requests` and bumping `stream_idle_timeout` to 60s for the impacted gateway set. Command: ```kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-config -p '{"data":{"upstream_max_pending_requests":"2000","stream_idle_timeout":"60s"}}'``` will push config via CI. applying now.
sre_tess: also turning on per-connection small write window to avoid head-of-line stalls: will push a haproxy tune too.
metrics-bot: updated metrics after first mitigations (02:18): p99=1.1s p95=420ms streaming-retries=0.4% connections-open reduced by 18% on gw-7 group.
oncall-elaine: good improvement. still seeing intermittent stalls (tailers). request logs show a subset of clients with very slow ack/read rates -> likely slow consumer/backpressure. Customer CS note: some mobile clients (poor networks) hit this harder.
customer-success-amy: adding a note to the affected account with mitigations and ETA for full resolution. they'll accept follow-up postmortem.
eng-runtime: longer-term action: add per-connection heartbeats for SSE to detect slow consumers earlier and drop them after grace, and add adaptive chunk sizing for mobile clients. I'll open an RFC.
ryan_infra: took a snapshot of gateway memory + net stats and rotated some overloaded instances out of the LB pool. That helped the worst of the buffer saturation.
sre_tess: next steps for oncall handoff: document what we changed (envoy config, haproxy tune, route weight) and keep watch for 1h. If p99 < 700ms and retries < 0.5% we can relax.
next-oncall-lee: taking over at 03:00. I'll keep this as a watch ticket. please ping me in #incidents if anything regresses.
oncall-elaine: summary for handoff -> changed envoy upstream limits, bumped stream_idle_timeout, temporarily routed 15% to fallback pool, tuned haproxy write windows, rotated overloaded gateways out. customer notified. monitoring alert thresholds tightened for streaming p95/p99 and slow reads metric.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT INC-3505555555 status=watching owner=next-oncall-lee actions=[envoy-config-patch,weight-shift,fallback-pool,cs-notified]
next-oncall-lee: acked. will monitor for next 60m and escalate if p99 > 1s or retries > 0.6%.
eng-runtime: I also deployed a lightweight patch that disables cross-request batching for streaming endpoints on the affected nodes to reduce head-of-line coupling. Deploy id: deploy/streaming-hotfix-350555.
sre_tess: please paste the exact commands/PR refs in the incident doc. we'll produce a short RCA template once stable.
customer-success-amy: thanks everyone, sharing update with customer now. they're appreciative of the fast mitigation.
next-oncall-lee: closing thread for now, will reopen if metrics breach thresholds. good job all. :thumbsup:
